notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content: We've just released the 1.01 update to Tippy Tree, this is a minor update with a few bug fixes, tweaks and added haptics when you pickup objects. Let us know if you have any feedback! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Tippy Tree Launch!
notes.content:
[b]Merry Christmas![/b] We're excited to announce that [b]Tippy Tree[/b] is now available just in time for the holidays. 

We made this game so that we have a perfect way to easily demo VR for friends and family during the holidays and we hope you'll also find it useful for sharing the awesomeness of VR :)

Please let us know if you have any questions, find bugs or have any feedback. Like with all of our games we plan to make improvements and add new features over time. 

Thanks again to everyone who has supported Mythical City Games through our previous games like Battle Fleet 2, Skytropolis and Snow Fortress. [b]Happy Holidays![/b]
